steps.note: Open the new event creation screen.

args.goal: On the new event create screen, open Edit Currencies, select Base Currency, choose a different available currency from Select Base Currency, enter a positive conversion factor in the input below it, click OK, verify the event shows the selected currency as its base currency, reopen Edit Currencies, and stop with the selected base currency and conversion factor visibly retained

steps.note: Perform and verify the currency editor flow, including persistence after reopening, which no catalog domain step can express.
Assert that the currency configuration subject remains visible on the resulting screen.
